data.name: Egg Hunter
data.detailed_description:
Embark on the ultimate open-world egg-hunting adventure across a variety of vibrant and dangerous landscapes. Explore everything from the Ice Tundra to lush tropical islands, each packed with hidden eggs waiting to be discovered. But collecting them won’t be easy—every region is filled with challenges, environmental hazards, and rival egg thieves determined to snatch your prizes before time runs out.

Take on timed runs where every second counts, navigate shifting day and night cycles, and outsmart clever NPC hunters who stalk the terrain searching for unguarded eggs. With three unique gameplay modes, you can explore at your own pace, compete against relentless AI rivals, or push your survival skills to their limits as you race the clock.

Whether you’re climbing icy cliffs, diving into tropical coves, or sprinting through wide-open landscapes, every hunt offers a fresh and thrilling experience. Gather rare eggs, master each biome, and become the world’s greatest egg hunter.

data.short_description: Explore vast open landscapes—from icy tundras to tropical islands—in this fast-paced egg-hunting adventure. Search for hidden eggs across dynamic day and night levels while racing against countdown timers and dodging thieves determined to steal your haul in Warriors' Call!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 760 / AMD Radeon R7 260x (2GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended for faster load times Recommended
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-7700 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580 (4GB+ VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
